UserProfile.title: User Profile
UserProfile.description: Private teacher or student account profile stored under their authenticated UID.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

displayName.description: Full display name for the teacher or student.

accountType.description: User portal persona chosen during registration.

classCode.description: Optional class or cohort identifier such as A2-BIO-9700.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

QuizProgress.title: Quiz Progress
QuizProgress.description: Saved Cambridge A2 9700 quiz answers and mastery counts for an authenticated user.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the progress owner.

answers.description: Map of syllabus question IDs to selected option indices.

totalAnswered.description: Count of questions answered by the user.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the progress document was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the progress document was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Private user profile documents for verified teachers and students.

/users/{userId}/progress/{progressId}.description: Private quiz answer progress subcollection gated by the parent user profile.
